about_the_game:
Z.O.N.A: Origin — Support Pack. This additional DLC is made for those who wish to support the developer and receive a small but atmospheric gear pack to begin their journey in the Zone.

Includes:

  • AKS-74 “Survivor” – a unique assault rifle with rare camouflage.

  • 3 painted magazines for the AKS-74.

  • PM “Night Guest” – a modified Makarov pistol with a suppressor and custom skin.

  • Z.O.N.A Bank credit card – contains 2,500 coupons, useful for traders.

All items can be collected at the Free Stalkers base, in the Shelter. They are activated automatically when starting a new game or upon first login after purchasing the pack. Weapons included in the pack have increased durability. Cosmetic items do not affect game balance and provide no combat advantage.

Thank you for supporting the development!

Your help allows us to keep improving the game with new locations, quests, and features.
